summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Ooredoo Privileges Laravel application login functionality. All core features working correctly with one CSRF token issue identified.

ui_bugs.issue: CSRF token issue causing 419 'Page Expired' error on form submission
ui_bugs.details: Form submits but returns 419 error due to missing or expired CSRF token. This is a Laravel security feature that needs proper token handling.

passed_tests: Login page loads correctly at /login with proper styling
Login page has email and password fields (French labels)
Login form elements are interactive and functional
Application correctly redirects unauthenticated users to /login
API endpoints /api/dashboard/data and /api/dashboard/kpis return 302 redirect (properly protected)
Static assets and CSS load properly (inline/embedded styling working)
OTP login functionality accessible via 'Connexion par code OTP' link
OTP login page loads with proper email field and submit button
Forgot password functionality accessible via 'Mot de passe oublié' link
Forgot password page loads with proper form elements
Navigation between login, OTP, and forgot password pages works correctly
Purple gradient background and white form styling displays correctly
French localization working properly throughout the interface
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix CSRF token handling in login form. The form submission returns 419 'Page Expired' error. Need to ensure CSRF token is properly included in form submissions or add @csrf directive to the login form blade template.
